name: Plex Offline
description: A simple Python command-line tool for searching a shared Plex library and downloading media for offline viewing. Sign in with your Plex account (2FA supported), search interactively, pick a movie, season or episodes, and it downloads the original file with a progress bar, plus external subtitles in your chosen language. No re-encoding and no ffmpeg needed. Login and server choice are cached, and flags make it scriptable.
